book.name: 2 CORINTIOS
book.title: ISCAB CARTA NAJ SAN PABLO YATO TET MACTA AYXACO YUL ISKꞌAB COMAM BEY CORINTO

content: Yuxin xaintxumilojan tato mach chintohan ilwal teyin̈ hunelxa, yun̈e machi cam chiwacojan biscꞌulal texol hununex.
Yuto ta chintohan wakꞌaꞌcojan biscꞌulal teyin̈, ¿mactaxca xin chu yakꞌni tzalaho wanmahan? Wal xin mach chisje incꞌulan wakꞌacojan biscꞌulal texol, yuto caw hex cheyakꞌ tzalahilal yul wanmahan.

Yuxin watojan incartahan teyet yun̈e mach cheyakꞌ biscꞌulal wabeꞌan yet chinapnihan bay ayex tuꞌ. Haꞌ heyet to tzalahilal cheyakꞌ wabeꞌan. Wal xin tꞌin̈anxa wehan ta hesunil chextzalapaxoj, hacaꞌ huneꞌ tzalahilal ayco yin̈ wanmatiꞌan.

Hayet wanitojan huneꞌ incartatuꞌan teyet, caw wikꞌ biscꞌulalan, caw quinokꞌan heyu, yaj maẍtaj yu yoc biscꞌulal teyin̈ yuxin intzꞌibn̈etojan huneꞌ carta tuꞌ, walxinto yun̈e heyilni tato xahan ayex wuhan.
Yakꞌ nimancꞌulal naj Pablo yin̈ huneꞌ naj yaco ismul
Ay huneꞌ mac anico biscꞌulal, yajaꞌ maẍn̈etajinan wabehan huneꞌ biscꞌulal tuꞌ, to hex heyabepaxo nichꞌan. “Nichꞌan” quinchiyan yuto mach chisje incꞌulan tato chichꞌib isyaꞌtajil naj tuꞌ yiban̈.
Haꞌ texol tuꞌ etza hesunil heyaco isyaꞌtajil yiban̈ naj, yajaꞌ cꞌuxanxa isyaꞌtajil heyaco yiban̈ naj tuꞌ.
Haxa tinan̈ xin, akꞌwe nimancꞌulal yin̈ naj, iptzewe naj haxinwal matxa chislahico biscꞌulal yin̈ naj.
Yuxin chiwalpaxtojan teyet ta chexahann̈e naj hacaꞌticꞌa yet yalan̈tocanoj.
Yu huneꞌ tuꞌ, yuxin intzꞌibn̈etojan huneꞌ incartatuꞌan teyet yun̈e wilnihan ta yijemex yin̈ tzet chiwalan teyet.

Haꞌ mac cheyakꞌ nimancꞌulal yin̈ yu hunu istxꞌojal chiswatxꞌe, chiwakꞌpaxo nimancꞌulalan yin̈, waxan̈ca mach wetojan yaco ismul, yajaꞌ heyu yuxin chiwakꞌan nimancꞌulal, yu iscꞌulalo teyin̈ sata Comam Jesucristo.
Hac tuꞌ chijute haxinwal mach chikꞌoji naj matzwalil jin̈, yuto johtaxa tzet chu yoc naj etlo jin̈.
Mach tzala iscꞌul naj Pablo yet yecꞌ naj bey Troas
Hayet wapnihan bey con̈ob Troas yu walnicꞌojan Tzotiꞌ cꞌul yet colbanile yin̈ Comam Jesucristo, caw yakꞌ isba munil wetan yin̈ yet Comam.
Yaj oc hanicꞌ biscꞌulal yin̈ wanmahan, yuto machi ilcha juẍta Tito wuhan bey tuꞌ, yuxin quintakꞌlicanojan tet ebnaj juẍtaj ay bey tuꞌ, intohan yul ismajul Macedonia.
Chon̈kꞌoji yuto ayxaco Comam Jesucristo jetbihoj

Jakꞌaꞌ yuchꞌandiosal tet Comam Dios yuto yu Comam Jesucristo yuxin sunilbal tiempo chon̈kꞌoji. Han̈on̈ xin chon̈iskꞌan Comam yu jakꞌni ohtan̈elaxo Istzotiꞌ tet anma. Haꞌ huneꞌ Tzotiꞌ tuꞌ caw sunil bay chipujnatoj, hacaꞌ yecꞌ isxukꞌal sam hunu tzet ye tuꞌ caw xukꞌ sam.
Han̈on̈ tiꞌ hacaꞌ isxukꞌal sam pom chiyeni iscꞌulal Comam Cristo yin̈ sat Comam Dios, hac tuꞌ jehi yet chon̈ecꞌ jalno Istzotiꞌ Comam tet anma chicolchahi yeb xin tet anma chicꞌaytoj.

Haꞌ mac chicꞌaytoj yahbeta sam huneꞌ Tzotiꞌ cꞌul yet colbanile yul sat yuto ayco yin̈ camical, walpaxo mac chicolcha xin, caw xukꞌ sam chabe yuto chischah iskꞌinal tet Comam. ¿Mactaxca xin chikꞌoji iswatxꞌen huneꞌ munil tiꞌ?

Yuto han̈on̈tiꞌan̈ maẍtaj yu jikꞌnihan̈ melyu yuxin chon̈ecꞌan̈ jalaꞌcꞌojan̈ Istzotiꞌ Comam Dios hacaꞌ chute huntekꞌanxa ebnaj soman ye isnabal. Wal xin caw hacaꞌticꞌa caw ye yul sat Comam Dios, hac tuꞌ chu jalnicꞌojan̈, yuto haꞌ Comam akꞌn̈e huneꞌ comuniltiꞌan̈, yeb hunxan̈e jehan̈ yin̈ Comam Jesucristo.
